exposure: skin-to-skin contact (SSC) duration after caesarean sections (CSs)
Duration of SSC (none, <30 min, 30-59 min, 60-89 min, at least 90 min)
Duration of skin-to-skin contact (SSC) after caesarean section
cohort: 679 participants with singleton pregnancy who delivered by elective CS after 37 gestational weeks using epidural or spinal anesthesia
finding: Immediate and longer duration of skin-to-skin contact after caesarean section was strongly associated with higher rates of early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Immediate and longer duration of skin-to-skin contact after caesarean section was strongly associated with higher rates of early initiation of breastfeeding.
